description: Inspect audit events: the immutable record of who did what, when. Actions: list_instance (instance-wide, admin-only), list_group / list_project (a group or project audit trail), get (a single event by ID - pass project_id or group_id for group/project events, neither for an instance event). Premium/Ultimate feature; there is no write counterpart because audit events cannot be modified.

action.description: Action to perform: list_instance, list_group, list_project, get

audit_event_id.description: Numeric audit-event ID (from a list action). Required for 'get' action(s).

created_after.description: Return events created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for 'list_instance', 'list_group', 'list_project' action(s).

created_before.description: Return events created on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Required for 'list_instance', 'list_group', 'list_project' action(s).

entity_id.description: Filter by the numeric ID of the entity (used with entity_type). Required for 'list_instance' action(s).

entity_type.description: Filter by entity type, e.g. 'User', 'Group', 'Project', 'Key'. Required for 'list_instance' action(s).

group_id.description: Group ID or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'my-group' or '42'). Required for 'list_group', 'get' action(s).

per_page.description: Number of items per page (default: 20, max: 100) Required for 'list_instance', 'list_group', 'list_project' action(s).

project_id.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path (e.g. 'group/project' or '123'). Required for 'list_project', 'get' action(s).

name: browse_audit_events
